purpose: Second surface-authorship calibration pilot: remove the asymmetric TAFKA-vs-Dharma register/platform mismatch by training Joel on other Dharma Connection speaker-labeled sources in leave-one-shared-source-group-out evaluation.

fold_training.joel_rule: two non-heldout Joel-only Dharma supplement documents plus all Joel matched-queue documents except the current held-out source group
fold_training.control_rule: six largest explicit-speaker non-overlap Dharma profile documents for each control

interpretation.comparison_target: Compare especially Joel per-author accuracy and char-only versus word-only behavior against the cross-register pilot. Improvement in char-only Joel attribution under same-platform training would support register mismatch as a real confound; persistence of word-only dominance would weaken the idiolect interpretation.
